papers.title_en: Replaying the Movie in Your Mind Decoding Dynamic Visual Perception and Recall from EEG
papers.authors: Zikai Fang, Tian-Yi Zhou, Xuan-Hao Liu, Yixi Li, Xiaoyu Xing, Yutong Pei, Bao-Liang Lu, Wei-Long Zheng
papers.tldr: 针对脑电解码动态视觉内容，感知研究已较深入，但内部回忆的神经表征保留情况不明。本文提出 PAIR 基准，由20名参与者交错进行自然视频观看与即时回忆，系统比较感知与回忆在层级语义分类、元特征解码及状态解码中的表现。结果显示多数模型-任务组合两者数值相近，但状态层面高度可分离，为研究内部视觉表征提供了新工具和证据。
papers.abstract_en: Decoding dynamic visual content from EEG has advanced rapidly for visual perception, yet it remains unclear which aspects of neural representations are preserved when people internally replay dynamic scenes. We introduce PAIR, an EEG benchmark collected from 20 participants using an interleaved, clip-wise paradigm that pairs naturalistic video viewing with immediate visual recall. This design enables a comparison between externally driven perception and internally generated recall for the same stimulus content within a fixed trial sequence. We benchmark multiple decoding models on hierarchical semantic classification at both fine-grained and coarse-grained levels, meta-feature decoding tasks covering motion, color, object number, face, and human presence, and a state-decoding task that discriminates perception from recall. Within-subject validation results show numerically similar performance for several model--task combinations, alongside higher perception accuracy in two coarse-grained comparisons after multiple-comparison correction. In contrast, perception and recall are highly separable at the state level under the present validation protocol. State accuracy remains high after alpha-band ablation, although this does not exclude ocular or other task-related contributions.

papers.title_en: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
papers.authors: Haonan Wang, Yuchen Wang, Jingyu Lu, Qixiang Zhang, Lehan Wang, Xuanqi Huang, Xiaomeng Li
papers.evidence: fMRI视觉重建用于脑机接口
papers.tldr: 针对fMRI视觉解码中视觉合理性不等于神经忠实性的问题，Neurons++提出统一视觉流框架，同时支持图像和视频重建。方法上采用图像-fMRI预训练初始化，再分别微调，以串行皮层启发解码组织空间、语义、语言和时间线索。实验显示视频重建达最优，图像重建有竞争力，且具备神经可解释性和方向可控性。
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

papers.title_en: MindVLM: Neural-Grounded Visual Captioning via Subject-Aware Semantic Evidence Selection
papers.authors: Zixiang Yin, Yu-Ping Wang, Zhengming Ding
papers.evidence: 将视觉脑活动翻译成自然语言
papers.tldr: 现有基于 NSD 的脑 captioning 依赖 MS-COCO 全场景标题作为间接监督，但 fMRI 采集时仅观察裁剪区域，导致神经表征与文本监督存在语义损失。为此，本文提出 MindVLM，将脑 captioning 重新定义为神经锚定的视觉 captioning：将 fMRI 信号映射为主体感知视觉 token，并利用冻结视觉语言模型生成个性化描述，无需文本监督或训练 LLM。在 NSD 上，MindVLM 在多个 VLM 骨干上持续提升 caption 质量，且与监督方法具有竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Translating visual brain activity into natural language offers a powerful window into human cognition and neural semantic representation. Most prior brain-captioning approaches project fMRI signals into language space using paired supervision. However, the widely used Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) was built based only on image-fMRI pairs, while existing methods rely on MS-COCO captions as indirect textual supervision. Critically, during fMRI acquisition, participants observe only cropped image regions, whereas the associated MS-COCO captions describe full scenes. This mismatch creates a fundamental gap between neural representations and textual supervision, introducing an inherent semantic loss in NSD-based brain captioning. To mitigate this limitation, we reformulate brain captioning as Neural-Grounded Visual Captioning, where language is generated directly from visually grounded neural evidence rather than text supervision. We propose MindVLM, a framework that maps fMRI signals into subject-aware visual tokens and leverages a frozen vision language model (VLM) to produce interpretable and personalized descriptions. Instead of point-wise regression, MindVLM focuses on extracting semantically relevant visual cues from neural activity, naturally accommodating partial observability and inter-subject variability. Extensive experiments on NSD show that MindVLM consistently improves caption quality across multiple VLM backbones, including LLaVA-v1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemma3, beyond intrinsic model priors. Despite requiring neither text supervision nor an LLM during training and operating under an image-grounded inference paradigm distinct from conventional captioning methods, MindVLM remains competitive with supervised approaches, suggesting that subject-specific neural grounding provides an efficient, scalable, and interpretable path toward faithful brain-to-language generation.

papers.authors: Xuan Wen, Yonghao Song, Yuhong Zhang, Guoliang Li, Tzyy-Ping Jung, Xiaorong Gao
papers.evidence: 语言监督神经解码提升BCI语音、运动、视觉解码
papers.tldr: 脑机接口通常使用类标签监督解码，但类间关系隐含。本文提出语言作为监督（LaS），将神经特征与自然语言类描述对齐，通过候选文本原型进行分类。在视觉、运动和语音解码任务中评估，LaS相比标签监督基线将语音解码准确率提高最多17.15个百分点，并支持候选集复用、受试者/会话适应及未见频率解码，表明文本描述可作为神经解码的通用参考。
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces decode neural activity, yet class-label supervision (CLS) leaves relationships among classes implicit. We propose Language as Supervision (LaS), which aligns neural features with natural-language class descriptions through learned projections and predicts classes using candidate text prototypes. We evaluate seven encoder architectures with independently trained models for visual, motor, and speech decoding from scalp and intracranial recordings. LaS improves speech-decoding accuracy by up to 17.15~pp over matched CLS baselines. Its representations support candidate-set reuse and label-supervised subject and session adaptation, while LaS enables conditional unseen-frequency decoding in steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) responses. Correct class-description correspondence supports this generalization, and dual-sided attribution visualization shows neural and textual contributions to the same class-matching score. These findings suggest that text descriptions can serve as general-purpose references for learning and interpretation in neural decoding.

papers.title_en: Nimbus Studio reproduces reference BCI decoding pipelines: a validation study on public benchmarks across protocols and paradigms
papers.evidence: 在公开基准上验证包括时序解码算法在内的标准BCI解码流程
papers.tldr: 本研究验证了可视化脑机接口（BCI）流水线平台Nimbus Studio的数值可靠性。作者在三个公共数据集上，使用六种标准解码流水线和两种评估协议，将平台执行结果与基于MNE-Python等的独立参考实现进行对比。结果表明，所有确定性流水线结果完全匹配，深度模型在种子间变异性内一致，证明该平台执行引擎与参考栈计算相同科学，可支持可信BCI研究。
papers.abstract_en: Nimbus Studio is a visual pipeline platform for brain-computer interface (BCI) experiments: researchers assemble preprocessing, feature extraction, decoding, and evaluation over public benchmark datasets or their own recordings, with cross-validated evaluation protocols (including leave-one-subject-out), BIDS export, and bring-your-own Python model classes. Whether its numbers can be trusted is a fair question for any such platform. We answer it with a parity study: six standard BCI decoding pipelines (CSP+LDA, Riemannian MDM, tangent-space logistic regression through the platform's bring-your-own-code node, P300 xDAWN+LDA, and the deep ShallowConvNet and EEGNet) were evaluated on three public datasets (motor-imagery BNCI-2014-001/004; P300 BNCI-2014-009) under two protocols (per-subject session holdout and pooled leave-one-subject-out cross-validation via the platform's planned-CV driver), once through Nimbus Studio's execution engine and once through independent, hand-written reference implementations built directly on MNE-Python, scikit-learn, pyriemann, and braindecode. Every deterministic pipeline matched the reference exactly (0.00 points maximum difference across all 54 session-holdout subject-runs and all CSP/MDM grouped-CV folds), including pipelines through the bring-your-own-code node and the CV orchestration; the remaining grouped-CV cells agree to floating-point precision (worst case 0.06 points, about one trial per fold). The stochastic deep models agreed within seed-to-seed training variability, estimated with multi-seed reruns on each side. The platform's execution engine therefore computes the same science as the reference stack across protocols, paradigms, and extensibility surfaces. The platform is available at https://studio.nimbusbci.com/, and the complete harness and per-subject results accompany this paper for independent verification.

papers.title_en: Learning structured linear dynamical systems from missing observations
papers.authors: Aravinda Kanchana Ruwanpathirana, Hemant Tyagi, Sunny G. W. Wang
papers.evidence: 从缺失观测中学习线性动态系统；可应用于神经群体动力学模型
papers.tldr: 本文研究从缺失观测中学习结构化线性动力系统的问题，系统参数限定在凸集内且每个时间点仅能观测到少量变量。作者提出一种最小化偏差校正目标函数的估计器，并给出非渐近统计误差界，该界依赖凸集的局部复杂度、轨迹长度和子采样概率。同时证明了投影梯度下降算法的收敛性。理论应用于子空间、双保序矩阵和Lipschitz行采样矩阵等结构，表明在轨迹长度远短于无约束情形且采样概率趋于零时，仍能有效恢复转移矩阵。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning structured linear dynamical systems over convex sets $\mathcal{K}$, where only a small subset of the observations are available at each time point. An estimator which minimizes a bias-corrected, potentially non-convex objective function is proposed. Non-asymptotic bounds are obtained for the statistical error, which depend on the local complexity of $\mathcal{K}$, the trajectory length $T$, and the sub-sampling probability $p$. Convergence of the projected gradient descent algorithm is also established. The general theory is applied to settings where (i) $\mathcal{K}$ is a subspace, (ii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of bi-isotonic matrices, and (iii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of matrices whose rows are formed by sampling Lipschitz functions. We show meaningful recovery of the transition matrix is possible for values of $T$ much smaller than what is required in the unconstrained case, and for $p = o(1)$.

papers.title_en: FlyHack: Stress-Testing Mechanistic Claims in a Connectome-Constrained Visual Model
papers.evidence: 对连接组约束神经网络模型中的机制声明进行压力测试
papers.tldr: 研究对连接组约束视觉模型flyvis的机制结论进行压力测试，发现其行为与机制结论受比较模型、干预方式、电路表示和具体训练解影响。通过50模型集成、任务匹配因果CNN对照和重复干预，揭示模型行为差异及归因评分敏感性，主张此类模型的结论需限定在模型家族、干预、表示和训练解范围内。
papers.abstract_en: Connectome-constrained neural networks make biological components directly accessible to intervention, but their mechanistic conclusions can still depend on the comparison model, intervention, circuit representation and trained solution. We stress-test these dependencies in flyvis, a \emph{Drosophila} motion-vision model, using its 50-model ensemble, task-matched causal CNN controls and replicated interventions. At the level of model behaviour, three-level reverse-phi reversal in flyvis is strongly period- and velocity-dependent and also appears in task-matched CNNs; neither family reproduces the fly's stationary-sawtooth response. Adversarial direction reversal requires a perturbation bound of 0.21--0.27 times stimulus contrast in flyvis versus 0.13--0.25 in CNNs, but the gap over a parameter-matched CNN largely closes for larger CNNs. At the level of mechanism, matching attribution to the intervention matters: for held-out-mean replacement, first-order edge attribution patching reaches pooled AUROC 0.970 and Spearman 0.872, versus 0.933 and 0.126 when its zero-aligned score is evaluated against the same ground truth. Circuit conclusions also vary with representation and ensemble member. Greedy cell-type sets meet a model-relative T4/T5 tuning criterion in 25 of 50 models, while T4/T5 output silencing reduces the tested optic-flow behaviour to at most two of eight clips in 40. In six models where the cell-type search first succeeds, the corresponding connection sets can be pruned to 13--31 added classes; under an additional two-sided response-amplitude check, only two of those six first-success cell-type sets still meet the tuning threshold. These results support a narrower use of connectome-constrained models: they make mechanistic hypotheses directly testable, but the resulting claims must be scoped to the model family, intervention, representation and trained solution.
